notes.title: Lyterian Games Preps Demo Launch
notes.content:
[p][/p][h1][b]Hello Seeing Red Community![/b] [/h1][p][/p][h3][b]🔥 Big Things Are Happening at Lyterian Games 🔥[/b][/h3][h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][h3]We’ve been quietly grinding behind the scenes, and it’s finally time to let you in on what we’ve been building. The team has grown. More talent, more creativity, and more momentum than ever before. That means better content, deeper stories, and a more terrifyingly immersive experience for you.[/h3][h3][b]We’re thrilled to announce that we’re putting the final touches on the First [i]Official[/i] Seeing Red Demo.[/b]
This isn’t just another test. This is a descent into the nightmare itself.[/h3][h3]Unlike our previous playtest that focused on mechanics, this demo will give you a real taste of the horror, tension, and twisted beauty that lies at the heart of [i]Seeing Red[/i]. What you’ll see, hear, and feel is just the beginning.[/h3][h3]We’ll be posting a lot more moving forward. There’s so much we’ve been dying to show you. New gameplay reveals. Creature teases. World-building drops. Maybe even a few chilling surprises.[/h3][h3][b]Get ready. Stay close. The nightmare is coming.[/b][/h3][h3]🩸 [b]Sign up for our newsletter[/b] to get exclusive behind-the-scenes lore, character reveals, early access content, and more:
[/h3][p]The darkness is watching.
[b]Will you dare to look back?[/b][/p][p][/p][h1][url="https://linktr.ee/lyterianGames"]https://linktr.ee/lyterianGames[/url][/h1]

notes.title: 🩸 Seeing Red Featured on 24indie – A New Dawn in Survival Horror
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that Seeing Red has just been featured on 24indie.com, a fast-growing indie game news portal focused on spotlighting fresh, standout titles.

The article dives into the eerie world of Seeing Red, exploring its mix of classic survival horror tension, resource management, and psychological storytelling. If you’ve been craving a new horror experience that goes beyond jump scares — this is your chance to step into the shadows.

👁️‍🗨️ Read the full feature here:
👉 https://24indie.com/seeing-red-a-new-dawn-in-survival-horror/

A "bloody" thanks to the team at 24indie for the thoughtful coverage; and to all of you for surviving with us. Stay alert... and stay quiet. 🔦👣
